replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body: If you are making it on a server you can download a plugin called "Cleanroom" or "EmptyWorldGenerator" that will do it for you with multiverse.

replies.author: Kammeh
replies.body: When you go to make a world, make it a flatland, and "Custom Prefix" or something like that comes up, what you do is enter 0,0 or 0,1 into the typing box. When the world is made, it is a blank world. :D Then you can use setblock commands to set a block next to you and start :DDD
